hypothesis: Current develop mutates URLSession requests repeatedly when resume is intercepted more than once, although asynchronous lifecycle starts are deduplicated. A task-identity claim before handler mutation can make interception exactly once without new scene dependencies.

baseline.remote_verification: Authenticated GitHub ref lookup; SSH fetch agent failed; recheck before worktree creation

decisive_tests: One mutating request-handler call and one lifecycle start for repeated first-party task resume; baseline must fail mutation count
Suspend/resume preserves prepared request and one start
Registered delegate and dual instrumentation preserve one start/completion
Concurrent first entry is exactly once
Completion removes per-task state without leaks; post-completion resume must not reinstrument a completed task
Header/sampling and third-party behavior match baseline
environment: Isolated clean current-develop worktree; Xcode27.1; newly available iPad iOS17.5; one build/device controller
admission_rule: Only a demonstrated baseline customer defect permits E01 implementation. Green focused controls plus scoped module/client/platform/performance checks are required for release; no gate closes from availability or source prediction.
timebox: Two hours for the first baseline reproducer and narrow repair qualification; stop equivalent infrastructure retries after two unchanged failures and continue independent documented work.
stop_rules: No baseline failure: record not eligible and choose the next fixed candidate without transplanting branch-specific behavior
Failed environment is not a correctness verdict; retain build/test diagnostics and exact IDs
New related correctness regression must be bounded and linked to E01; unrelated work remains separate
